description: Every identity in the live inventory -- IAM roles and users, GCP service accounts -- is placed by the identity register in exactly the role model's terms: its kind, lane, credential and where it is declared

matrix_rows.gap: Each identity maps to one register entry, and so to one lane; the entry's lane is not compared with the identity's live permissions.
Every non-user identity has a recorded credential position; there is no periodic credential review beyond the daily checks on keys, trusts and sessions.

Attribution to Terraform is by the register's declared_in; three identities are not Terraform's -- AWS's service-linked roles, Google's default compute account, and the hand-made GCP Terraform Admin, each said so. There is no SCIM.

Non-human identities only. The human identities -- the Identity Center user, the Google account, root -- are not inventoried types; the register lists them, and the APM checks judge their credentials.
